- If we keep Option A, I’d rather I take the last 20 minutes to cover compliance/roadmap while you handle discovery and intro.

Also — can we add a follow-up 30-min slot next week for a technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer? Suggested: Thu, Jun 3 — 09:30 CEST (evening PT). I’ll add that as a tentative placeholder in the MAP.

If you want, I’ll edit the MAP and re-upload with the EU-friendly calendar labels.

—Olga
